code_summary: One independent MaskedSASRec per category: 96-dimensional tied item embeddings, learned positional embeddings, two bidirectional Transformer blocks with two heads, dropout 0.2, and a linear/GELU/LayerNorm output head. Scores use unnormalized tied dot products plus jointly trained item biases. Training masks the final target and randomly masks 20% of context positions. Two passes through the same network use independent dropout and identical 256 sampled negatives with accidental-target exclusion. The objective averages both reconstruction losses and adds 0.1 times float32 symmetric KL over final-mask candidate distributions. AdamW uses learning rate 0.0006; training allows 200 epochs with patience 25 and a 2400-second category limit. Each category exports exactly one selected checkpoint and uses one inference forward pass. Code includes scoring, finite-gradient, and exported-predictor parity checks.
